title: PriceRule - Pricing Module Data Models Reference

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the PriceRule data model. It belongs to the Pricing Module.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the price rule.

types.name: attribute
types.description: The attribute of the price rule. For example, `region_id`.

types.name: value
types.description: The value of the price rule. For example, `reg_123`.

types.name: operator
types.description: The operator of the price rule. For example, `eq`.

types.name: priority
types.description: The priority of the price rule.

children.name: amount
children.description: The amount of the price.

children.name: min_quantity
children.description: The minimum quantity that must be available in the cart for the price to be applied.

children.name: max_quantity
children.description: The maximum quantity allowed to be available in the cart for the price to be applied.

children.name: rules_count
children.description: The total number of rules of the price.
